name: Kanha Gupta
bio: Hey! I'm Kanha Gupta — a Full-Stack Developer currently working as a Software Engineering Analyst at Accenture, Bengaluru. I specialise in building robust, scalable applications using .NET, C#, Angular, and SQL Server.

My journey in software development began at LNCT Group of Colleges, Bhopal, where I graduated with a B.Tech in Computer Science. Since then I've delivered enterprise features at LTIMindtree and Accenture — from RESTful APIs and EF Core-powered data layers to Angular modules and AI-powered workspaces using Gemini AI and RAG.
Outside of work I enjoy solving algorithmic problems on LeetCode and GeeksForGeeks, exploring AI/ML technologies, and building personal projects that tackle real-world problems.
